concept.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: photographic art-direction concept for the interactive final table of a culinary olympiad. A NEW natural composition, not a catalog and not a mockup of pasted cutouts.
Input Image 1 is ONLY the reference for the same male white-shirted travel guest and warm real restaurant. Do not copy its empty-table layout.
Make a genuine believable editorial food photograph as if a professional photographer stood beside a real served restaurant table. Camera at a natural seated-diner/elevated 25-30 degree angle, three-quarter view along the table from its near right corner, less top-down. The guest sits on the left side at the far half, his face, shoulders and hands naturally visible, looking at the meal close to him with quiet pleasure. Keep his identity and white shirt. Window daylight soft and natural, wood furniture, plant-filled warm cafe background, authentic linen and understated cutlery, not an overly huge blank cloth stage.
EIGHT realistic human-scale served dishes arranged organically at different depths, on DIFFERENT appropriate ceramic dishes, like a real shared tasting supper, not equal tiny souvenir plates and not in repeated rows. A Margherita pizza on a 28 cm white plate, truly cut into eight wedges; modest Greek salad bowl with feta, tomato/cucumber/onion/olives/olive oil/oregano; platter of eight sliced Philadelphia uramaki, salmon OUTSIDE and cream cheese/cucumber INSIDE, accompanied by separate soy sauce, ginger, wasabi; croissant, ramen, khinkali, taco, tom yum as small tasting servings further along the table. Natural perspective, actual depth of bowls, truthful contact shadows and reflected warm light. Food close to the lens appears larger because of perspective but never bigger than a human body or absurdly oversized. Let dishes relate to seated diners and place settings; no uniform gallery spacing, no isolated food thumbnails, no collage effect, no harsh cutout white edges.
Each food has ONE VERY small realistic paper flag on a thin cocktail toothpick, physically inserted in the food or fixed to its edge. Correct flags: pizza Italy green-white-red vertical stripes; Greek salad Greece blue-white horizontal stripes and white cross on blue canton; Philadelphia US flag with blue canton and red-white stripes; croissant France blue-white-red vertical; ramen Japan white/red disc; khinkali Georgia white with red crosses; taco Mexico green-white-red with tiny central emblem; tom yum Thailand horizontal red-white-blue-white-red. Flag cloth/paper, sticks and printed graphics share the SAME lighting and camera as food. These should be tiny tasteful props and not the main visual. No floating flag icons.
One consistent photographic exposure and lens, 50mm editorial food photography look, full color, sharp recognizable central dishes, slightly softer restaurant background. LANDSCAPE photo fills canvas, no UI, no text, no labels, no drawings, no 3D aesthetic, no contact sheet.
